in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The One who has a bright picture or imagination.

in_marathi.name: Chitranjan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitranjan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chitranjan is a unisex name of Sanskrit origin, meaning 'Artistic Image'. It combines the words 'chitra' meaning 'picture or painting' and 'jan' meaning 'born'.
